provenance.notes: Zone B drop (R5-02.S3): the two 30x30 frames of the brood bubble's stir loop are the LEFT-column cells (sheet frames 1 and 3) of the owner-picked BROOD BUBBLE animation sheet (flux2 seed 33110, an edit of the picked single-design winner seed 471823308), cropped from the committed winner with a key border around each subject box. The left column is the clean pair: both cells are one enclosed sphere subject ~348 px across; the right-column band is 430 px wide with a frame-2 subject that fills its whole band edge to edge (a smeared or merged state), so the loop takes frames 1 and 3. The design carries its own 1-px near-black navy outline, so the outline pass is off.
